verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.pt: Faze a vingança dos filhos de Israel sobre os midianitas; depois serás recolhido a teus povos.
verses.en_web: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
verses.en_bbe: Give the Midianites punishment for the wrong they did to the children of Israel: and after that you will go to rest with your people.

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
verses.pt: Então Moisés falou ao povo, dizendo: Armai-vos alguns de vós para a guerra, e irão contra Midiã, e farão a vingança do SENHOR em Midiã.
verses.en_web: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses said to the people, Let men from among you be armed for war to put into effect against Midian the Lord's punishment on them.

verses.en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.pt: Mil de cada tribo de todas as tribos dos filhos de Israel, enviareis à guerra.
verses.en_web: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”
verses.en_bbe: From every tribe of Israel send a thousand to the war.

verses.en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.pt: Assim foram dados dos milhares de Israel, mil cada tribo, doze mil a ponto de guerra.
verses.en_web: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.en_bbe: So from the thousands of Israel a thousand were taken from every tribe, twelve thousand men armed for war.

verses.en: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.pt: E Moisés os enviou à guerra: mil cada tribo enviou: e Fineias, filho de Eleazar sacerdote, foi à guerra com os santos instrumentos, com as trombetas em sua mão para tocar.
verses.en_web: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses sent them out to war, a thousand from every tribe, and with them Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, taking in his hands the vessels of the holy place and the horns for sounding the note of war.

verses.en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.pt: E lutaram contra Midiã, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés, e mataram a todo homem.
verses.en_web: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
verses.en_bbe: And they made war on Midian, as the Lord gave orders to Moses; and they put to death every male.

verses.en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.pt: Mataram também, entre os mortos deles, aos reis de Midiã: Evi, e Requém, e Zur, e Hur, e Reba, cinco reis de Midiã; a Balaão também, filho de Beor, mataram à espada.
verses.en_web: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
verses.en_bbe: They put the kings of Midian to death with the rest, Evi and Reken and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian: and Balaam, the son of Beor, they put to death with the sword.

verses.en: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.pt: E levaram cativas os filhos de Israel as mulheres dos midianitas, e suas crianças e todos suas animais, e todos os seus gados; e arrebataram todos os seus pertences.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
verses.en_bbe: The women of Midian with their little ones the children of Israel took prisoner; and all their cattle and flocks and all their goods they took for themselves;

verses.en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.pt: E abrasaram com fogo todas suas cidades, aldeias e castelos.
verses.en_web: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
verses.en_bbe: And after burning all their towns and all their tent-circles,

verses.en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.pt: E tomaram todo o despojo, e toda a presa, tanto de homens como de animais.
verses.en_web: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
verses.en_bbe: They went away with the goods they had taken, man and beast.

verses.en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.pt: E trouxeram a Moisés, e a Eleazar o sacerdote, e à congregação dos filhos de Israel, os cativos e a presa e os despojos, ao acampamento nas planícies de Moabe, que estão junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
verses.en_web: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.en_bbe: And the prisoners and the goods and everything they had taken, they took to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the people of Israel, to the tent-circle in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.en: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.pt: E saíram Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote, e todos os príncipes da congregação, a recebê-los fora do acampamento.
verses.en_web: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs of the people went out to them before they had come into the tent-circle.

verses.en: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.pt: E irou-se Moisés contra os capitães do exército, contra os comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem que voltavam da guerra;
verses.en_web: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses was angry with the chiefs of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds who had come back from the war.

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.pt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Todas as mulheres preservastes?
verses.en_web: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to them, Why have you kept all the women safe?

verses.en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.pt: Eis que elas foram aos filhos de Israel, por conselho de Balaão, para causar transgressão contra o SENHOR no negócio de Peor; pelo que houve mortandade na congregação do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: It was these who, moved by Balaam, were the cause of Israel's sin against the Lord in the question of Peor, because of which disease came on the people of the Lord.

verses.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.pt: Matai, pois, agora todos os machos entre as crianças: matai também toda mulher que tenha conhecido homem carnalmente.
verses.en_web: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
verses.en_bbe: So now put every male child to death, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man.

verses.en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.pt: E todas as meninas entre as mulheres, que não tenham conhecido ajuntamento de homem, vos preservareis vivas.
verses.en_web: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: But all the female children who have had no sex relations with men, you may keep for yourselves.

verses.en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.pt: E vós ficai fora do acampamento sete dias: e todos os que houverem matado pessoa, e qualquer um que houver tocado morto, vos purificareis ao terceiro e ao sétimo dia, vós e vossos cativos.
verses.en_web: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
verses.en_bbe: You yourselves will have to keep outside the tent-circle for seven days, anyone of you who has put any person to death or come near a dead body; and on the third day and on the seventh day make yourselves and your prisoners clean.

verses.en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.pt: Também purificareis toda roupa, e todo artigo de peles, e toda obra de pelos de cabra, e todo vaso de madeira.
verses.en_web: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”
verses.en_bbe: And every bit of clothing, and anything made of leather or goats' hair or wood, you are to make clean.

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
verses.pt: E Eleazar o sacerdote disse aos homens de guerra que vinham da guerra: Esta é a ordenança da lei que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:
verses.en_bbe: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had been to the fight, This is the rule of the law which the Lord has given to Moses:

verses.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.pt: Certamente o ouro, e a prata, bronze, ferro, estanho, e chumbo,
verses.en_web: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.en_bbe: But gold and silver and brass and iron and tin and lead,

verses.en: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.pt: Tudo o que resiste ao fogo, por fogo o fareis passar, e será limpo, ainda que nas águas de purificação haverá de purificar-se: mas fareis passar por água tudo o que não aguenta o fogo.
verses.en_web: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
verses.en_bbe: And anything which may be heated, is to go through the fire and be made clean; but in addition it is to be put in the water of cleaning: and anything which may not go through the fire is to be put in the water.

verses.en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.pt: Além disso lavareis vossas roupas no sétimo dia, e assim sereis limpos; e depois entrareis no acampamento.
verses.en_web: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
verses.en_bbe: And on the seventh day, after washing your clothing, you will be clean, and then you may come into the tent-circle.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.pt: Toma a contagem da presa que se fez, tanto das pessoas como dos animais, tu e o sacerdote Eleazar, e os chefes dos pais da congregação:
verses.en_web: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
verses.en_bbe: Get an account of everything which was taken in the war, of man and of beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of families of the people:

verses.en: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.pt: E partirás pela metade a presa entre os que lutaram, os que saíram à guerra, e toda a congregação.
verses.en_web: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
verses.en_bbe: And let division be made of it into two parts, one for the men of war who went out to the fight, and one for all the people:

verses.en: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.pt: E separarás para o SENHOR o tributo dos homens de guerra, que saíram à guerra: de quinhentos um, tanto das pessoas como dos bois, dos asnos, e das ovelhas:
verses.en_web: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
verses.en_bbe: And from the men of war who went out let there be offered to the Lord one out of every five hundred, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep:

verses.en: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
verses.pt: Da metade deles o tomarás; e darás a Eleazar o sacerdote a oferta do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
verses.en_bbe: Take this from their part and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to be lifted up to the Lord.

verses.en: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
verses.pt: E da metade pertencente aos filhos de Israel tomarás um de cinquenta, das pessoas, dos bois, dos asnos, e das ovelhas, de todo animal; e os darás aos levitas, que têm a guarda do tabernáculo do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”
verses.en_bbe: And from the part given to the children of Israel, take one out of every fifty, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep, and give it to the Levites who have the care of the House of the Lord.

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: E fizeram Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.
verses.en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: So Eleazar and Moses did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

verses.en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.pt: E foi a presa, o resto da presa que tomaram os homens de guerra, seiscentas e setenta e cinco mil ovelhas,
verses.en_web: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.en_bbe: Now the beasts taken, in addition to what the fighting-men took for themselves, were six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,

verses.en: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.pt: E setenta e dois mil bois,
verses.en_web: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
verses.en_bbe: And seventy-two thousand oxen,

verses.en: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.pt: E setenta e um mil asnos;
verses.en_web: and sixty-one thousand donkeys,
verses.en_bbe: And sixty-one thousand asses;

verses.en: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.pt: E quanto às pessoas, de mulheres que não conheciam ajuntamento de homem, ao todo trinta e duas mil.
verses.en_web: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
verses.en_bbe: And thirty-two thousand persons, that is, women who had never had sex relations with a man.

verses.en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.pt: E a metade, a parte dos que haviam saído à guerra, foi o número de trezentas trinta e sete mil e quinhentas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:
verses.en_bbe: And the half given as their part to the men who went to the war, was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

verses.en: And the LORD’S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.pt: E o tributo para o SENHOR das ovelhas foi seiscentas e setenta e cinco.
verses.en_web: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
verses.en_bbe: Of which the Lord's part was six hundred and seventy-five.

verses.en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.pt: E dos bois, trinta e seis mil: e deles o tributo para o SENHOR, setenta e dois.
verses.en_web: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.
verses.en_bbe: The number of oxen was thirty-six thousand, of which the Lord's part was seventy-two;

verses.en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and one.
verses.pt: E dos asnos, trinta mil e quinhentos: e deles o tributo para o SENHOR, setenta e um.
verses.en_web: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.
verses.en_bbe: The number of asses was thirty thousand, five hundred, of which the Lord's part was sixty-one.

verses.en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD’S tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.pt: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil: e delas o tributo para o SENHOR, trinta e duas pessoas.
verses.en_web: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
verses.en_bbe: And the number of persons was sixteen thousand, of which the Lord's part was thirty-two persons.

verses.en: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: E deu Moisés o tributo, por elevada oferta ao SENHOR, a Eleazar o sacerdote, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.
verses.en_web: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses gave the Lord's part, lifted up as an offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

verses.en: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.pt: E da metade para os filhos de Israel, que separou Moisés dos homens que haviam ido à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
verses.en_bbe: And from the half given to the children of Israel, which Moses had kept separate from that given to the fighting-men,

verses.en: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.pt: (A metade para a congregação foi: das ovelhas, trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas;
verses.en_web: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
verses.en_bbe: (Now the people's half was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,

verses.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.pt: E dos bois, trinta e seis mil;
verses.en_web: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
verses.en_bbe: And thirty-six thousand oxen,

verses.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.pt: E dos asnos, trinta mil e quinhentos;
verses.en_web: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
verses.en_bbe: And thirty thousand, five hundred asses,

verses.en: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.pt: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil:)
verses.en_web: and sixteen thousand persons),
verses.en_bbe: And sixteen thousand persons;)

verses.en: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Da metade, pois, para os filhos de Israel tomou Moisés um de cada cinquenta, tanto das pessoas como dos animais, e deu-os aos levitas, que tinham a guarda do tabernáculo do SENHOR; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.
verses.en_web: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: Even from the children of Israel's half, Moses took one out of every fifty, men and beasts, and gave them to the Levites who had the care of the House of the Lord; as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

verses.en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.pt: E chegaram a Moisés os chefes dos milhares daquele exército, os comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem;
verses.en_web: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
verses.en_bbe: Then the men in authority over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came to Moses,

verses.en: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.pt: E disseram a Moisés: Teus servos tomaram a soma dos homens de guerra que estão em nosso poder, e nenhum faltou de nós.
verses.en_web: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
verses.en_bbe: And said to him, Your servants have taken note of the number of all the fighting-men under our orders, and every one is present;

verses.en: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
verses.pt: Pelo qual temos oferecido ao SENHOR oferta, cada um do que achou, objetos de ouro, braceletes, pulseiras, anéis, pendentes, e correntes, para fazer expiação por nossas almas diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And we have here an offering for the Lord from what every man took in the war, ornaments of gold, leg-chains and arm-rings, finger-rings, ear-rings, and neck-ornaments, to make our souls free from sin before the Lord.

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.pt: E Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar receberam o ouro deles, joias, todas elaboradas.
verses.en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, even all the worked ornaments.

verses.en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.pt: E todo o ouro da oferta que ofereceram ao SENHOR dos comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem, foi dezesseis mil setecentos e cinquenta siclos.
verses.en_web: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
verses.en_bbe: And the gold which the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds gave, as an offering to be lifted up before the Lord, came to sixteen thousand, seven hundred and fifty shekels.

verses.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.pt: Os homens do exército haviam despojado cada um para si.
verses.en_web: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
verses.en_bbe: (For every man of the army had taken goods for himself in the war.)

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.pt: Receberam, pois, Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar, o ouro dos comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem, e trouxeram-no ao tabernáculo do testemunho, por memória dos filhos de Israel diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold given by the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and took it into the Tent of meeting, to be a sign in memory of the children of Israel before the Lord.
